title: sigelo/0 attestation body
description: One world's signed statement about one identity (SPEC §5, §3.1). claims is world-defined and free-form, but every number in it is an integer in range and no key is __proto__ (SPEC §3). exp > iat is required too (not expressible here).

admission_by.description: Informational; names the voucher for admission: invite. Verifiers need not resolve it.
